Scope bar: an app-wide choice under the tab bar

Source: R/dt.R
kit_scope_bar.Rd

For a choice that every tab of the app depends on, such as which item bank is in use. It sits right under the tab bar, without a frame: a radio group (or a select), one line of small hint text (what is in use now, how big it is), small buttons on the right, and an optional area for what must be confirmed after choosing (a checklist and buttons). A thin line separates it from the page below.

Usage

kit_scope_bar(input, line = NULL, actions = NULL, panel = NULL)

Arguments

input

The input: usually shiny::radioButtons(..., inline = TRUE) (2–5 choices) or shiny::selectInput().

line

Tags or text for the hint line, for example "目前：TDCYP 題庫 · 412 題". NULL for none. Put dynamic parts in shiny::uiOutput() / shiny::textOutput(inline = TRUE).

actions

Small buttons on the right of the hint line (kit_button() with the default kind, kit_download_button(), shiny::fileInput()). A list or a single tag; NULL for none.

panel

Optional area under the line for what must be confirmed after choosing (for example a kit_checklist() and buttons, or a shiny::uiOutput()). NULL for none.

Value

<div class="kit-scopebar">.

Details

Markup: div.kit-scopebar > the input, div.kit-scopebar-line (line, then div.kit-scopebar-actions with actions), div.kit-scopebar-panel (panel). Use span.kit-scopebar-todo in line for something still to do ("還沒選題庫").

Examples

kit_scope_bar(
  shiny::radioButtons("bank", "題庫", c("TDCYP" = "tdcyp", "上傳自己的" = "own"),
                      inline = TRUE),
  line = "目前：TDCYP 題庫 · 412 題",
  actions = list(kit_button("bank_dl", "下載題庫"), kit_button("bank_new", "新增題庫"))
)
#> <div class="kit-scopebar">
#>   <div id="bank" class="form-group shiny-input-radiogroup shiny-input-container shiny-input-container-inline" role="radiogroup" aria-labelledby="bank-label">
#>     <label class="control-label" id="bank-label" for="bank">題庫</label>
#>     <div class="shiny-options-group">
#>       <label class="radio-inline">
#>         <input type="radio" name="bank" value="tdcyp" checked="checked"/>
#>         <span>TDCYP</span>
#>       </label>
#>       <label class="radio-inline">
#>         <input type="radio" name="bank" value="own"/>
#>         <span>上傳自己的</span>
#>       </label>
#>     </div>
#>   </div>
#>   <div class="kit-scopebar-line">
#>     目前：TDCYP 題庫 · 412 題
#>     <div class="kit-scopebar-actions">
#>       <button class="btn btn-default action-button btn-sm btn-outline-secondary" id="bank_dl" type="button"><span class="action-label">下載題庫</span></button>
#>       <button class="btn btn-default action-button btn-sm btn-outline-secondary" id="bank_new" type="button"><span class="action-label">新增題庫</span></button>
#>     </div>
#>   </div>
#> </div>
